description: Run a user-supplied prompt against a developer-provided OpenAI-compatible or custom REST HTTPS model endpoint. Use validate_custom_model to test URL and adapter settings before sending. Returns model-generated text, model name, optional usage, and account state. Requires active trial or Pro and transmits prompt content to the selected provider. Credentials are transient, not persisted; localhost/private networks are not supported.

adapterMode.description: Adapter for the target endpoint: openai-compatible or custom-rest.

apiKey.description: Transient authentication key sent to the chosen provider; never log or embed in prompts.

apiKeyHeader.description: Custom REST API-key authentication header name.

authMode.description: Custom REST authentication mode, default bearer.

baseUrl.description: Required public HTTPS base URL for openai-compatible mode.

endpoint.description: Required public HTTPS inference URL for custom-rest mode.

extraHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers required by the provider, if any.

inputLanguage.description: Language name or code of input text, e.g. es; defaults to EN.

maxTokens.description: Optional maximum output token count, subject to model limits.

model.description: Model identifier at the custom provider, when needed.

outputLanguage.description: Requested output language name or code, e.g. fr; defaults to EN.

prompt.description: Required nonempty prompt to send externally, maximum 30,000 characters.

promptField.description: Custom REST request JSON key for prompt content.

responseTextPath.description: Optional JSON response field/path containing generated text.

system.description: Optional system instructions supported by the endpoint.

systemField.description: Custom REST request JSON key for system instructions.

temperature.description: Optional response sampling randomness between 0 and 2.

uiLanguage.description: Interface language name or code, e.g. EN; independent of source and response languages.

name: run_custom_model
title: Run a custom model
